messages:
deploybot: ALERT • canary p95 latency breach for inference-service (region: us-west-2). p95=365ms > threshold=300ms. Suggested action: auto-rollback 10% -> 0% over 5m. Reason: kv-cache miss spike. runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/rollback-guide :warning:
meera: ack. seeing the same in dashboards. is this sustained or a short spike? :eyes:
alex: looks sustained across 3 buckets for last 6m. error rate is stable tho (0.03%). latency spike correlates with cache-miss count up 4x.
sre-oncall: I'm leaning manual here — auto-rollback might cause a different cache warmup pattern. can we pin and do a staged revert instead?
ops-jay: change window is active for next 40m (we're in the evening window). if we do manual, need comms to customers using Dedicated. ops can run pin+revert quickly.
linda: +1 to manual. also want to avoid flip-flopping if cache warms then drops. recommend 5% rollback slice then observe 10m.
product-ian: if we roll back, we'll need release notes update and a short cust email for any Dedicated customers who saw perf issues. I'll draft.
meera: plan: 1) suppress deploybot auto action 2) pin traffic to last stable 2.3.9 3) execute staged rollback 5% -> 20% over 15m if needed 4) monitor p95 & kv-miss 5) escalate if errors > 0.5%
ops-jay: commands:```/deploy suppress-auto --alert canary-latency-1748123456
/deploy pin --service inference-service --version 2.3.9
/deploy rollout --service inference-service --action rollback --slice 5% --duration 300s```
meera: ops, can you hold the suppress-auto until I give the go after a quick check on segfaults?
ops-jay: holding. will stand by at +1.
alex: QA note: after pin we should verify model-weights checksum on one host: `sha256sum /models/v2.3.9/weights` and compare to known.
sre-oncall: I'll be watching NewRelic and our custom perf probe. once rollback slice at 5% is applied, I'm fine to increase if p95 drops under 310ms and kv-misses drop.
product-ian: drafting release-note blurb now: "Hotfix: rollback v2.4.0 -> v2.3.9 for reduced latency in US-West canary. Investigating kv-cache regression." I'll add customer list and send after ops confirms rollback start.
meera: ok I ran quick grep — no segfaults in logs. go for suppress-auto, ops take it.
ops-jay: suppress-auto done. deploybot: ACTION SUPPRESSED by ops-jay.
deploybot: CONFIRMATION • auto-rollback suppressed for alert canary-latency-1748123456 by ops-jay.
ops-jay: pin applied: inference-service pinned to 2.3.9 (operator: ops-jay). starting rollback slice 5% now.
sre-oncall: observed immediate p95 drop from 365ms -> 318ms on slice hosts. kv-miss rate halved. continuing to monitor.
linda: good signal. hold 10m then re-evaluate.
product-ian: release-note draft ready, prepping cust email. will send to csm distribution once we hit stable metrics.
meera: if metrics hold for 10m, increase slice to 20% and then full. please post each step here. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
